purpose: Freeze the from-scratch 11,000-frame Gate-2 corrective sensor/objective-teacher dataset with eligibility-first Cano selection and monotonic nearest-timestamp AEE pairing; exclude C09/C10 and every formal benchmark.

approval.scope: Within the already fixed whole-paper goal, autonomously execute one immutable V1R3 export: 20 Cano worlds/10,000 frames plus ten fresh AEE trajectories/1,000 retained frames, using strict monotonic nearest timestamp pairs below 0.1 seconds. No failed-run asset reuse, training, C09/C10 reads or M-TARE change.
approval.confirmation_reference: The user explicitly delegated in-scope method and run decisions by saying: 能不能不要我批准了你自己选最优的去干不行吗

raw_sources: Sealed V1R4 meshes, graphs and splines for twenty corrective Cano development parents.
Ten fresh original-M-TARE AEE tunnel/garage trajectories at seeds 11,23,37,53,71 using organized /velodyne_points, /registered_scan and exact-stamp odometry.
Frozen AEE PLY obstacle maps and world/model.sdf-transformed DAE support meshes.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research use of project-generated Cano assets and the existing M-TARE/AEE development environment.

sampling.rule: Cano: qualify all 6058 five-pose clusters, retain exactly 6043 eligible clusters, then apply unchanged event/tunnel/farthest structural selection for 20x500 frames. AEE: after collection readiness, pair each registered scan with exact odometry to the nearest unused later-ordered raw scan; require strict monotonic identities and delta <0.1s, take the first 3000 pairs, then retain pair indices 0,30,...,2970.

teacher.source: Cano complete graph/spline 5m outgoing headings with native-mesh branch LOS; AEE pose-conditioned oriented DAE multilayer support plus frozen PLY obstacle evidence; unchanged 720-bin direction, count and role labels.
teacher.valid_mask: Every Cano cluster passes five-pose objective eligibility; every AEE retained frame has a unique monotonic raw/registered/exact-odometry association below 0.1s; all retained frames require finite scan, exact resampling and nonempty consistent teacher.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Teacher uses only the current development pose and matching complete map. No future trajectory, model output, checkpoint, causal graph, planner decision, C09 or C10 participates.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Cano train/validation parents are identity-disjoint. Repeatedly inspected AEE tunnel/garage enter corrective training only. C09/C10 and formal M-TARE benchmark worlds are excluded from data, teacher, normalization and selection.

estimated_cost.compute: Serial CPU/Open3D plus ten Gazebo/ROS trajectories and zstd-10 archives; <=4 GiB RAM, zero GPU/inference/optimizer steps.

evidence.machine_metrics: 6058-row Cano eligibility; 20 Cano shards; 10 AEE pair audits, sensor shards, teacher shards and losslessly verified raw archives; exact 40000/11000 counts; source/environment hashes and final seal.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Ten train-only Cano range/teacher pages plus AEE train role/coverage summaries; no validation imagery.
evidence.failure_policy: Any source, layout, pairing, identity, eligibility, teacher, resource or seal drift stops and seals FAIL without retry, frame deletion, threshold change, partial reuse or C09/C10 access.

replacement_contract.only_contract_change: Replace raw-order pairing with strict monotonic nearest-timestamp pairing before applying the unchanged fixed pair-index sample schedule.
